scope: Real Service Action/Output uploads/downloads through the same fixed 2-worker/64-wait/16MiB pool, deferred Front/helper/private IPC/OpenSSH to generated loopback sshd. 32MiB constant-buffer files exceed pool quota. Fourteen cases: both directions, existing target refusal and explicitly-approved primitive replacement, early streaming cancel, same-size source modification/remote mtime guard, stale remote selection, bad auth, streaming shutdown, concurrent upload+download. Simulated frontend supplies fixture passphrase; mutations/cancel injected only after observing early streaming, not a frozen deterministic network schedule. Actual publication/retained partial bytes and clean joined shutdown/independent status ownership checked. No Workspace transfer GUI/real SSH terminal pane/native IME, other-platform runtime, whole-process allocation/RSS cap, fair throughput comparison or long-idle acceptance. Process samples include harness/client/helper; server is separate owned fixture. No user SSH files or credentials.
